title: On a phone the customer window's representative fields work as on desktop
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have an active staff member at the test location with the "Sales Representative" switch on: sales rep A.
  • Create a customer for this test with no Sales Representative assigned.
  • Open the customer's page on a phone (a touch screen with no mouse pointer).
  • If you cannot set up any of the above, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Open Edit Customer.
  2. Tap the Sales Representative field.
  3. Tap sales rep A.
  4. Tap the +.
  5. Tap "Sales Representative - Service Parts".
  6. Tap the remove x beside "Sales Representative - Service Parts".
  7. Save the customer.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The Edit Customer window shows the Sales Representative field.
  • The + shows beside it without any hover.

Step 2:

  • The same native dropdown opens.

Step 3:

  • The field reads sales rep A.

Step 4:

  • A menu opens.

Step 5:

  • The first field is renamed "Sales Representative - Service Labor".
  • "Sales Representative - Service Parts" shows under it.
  • Both read sales rep A.

Step 6:

  • The first field reads "Sales Representative" again, holding sales rep A.

Step 7:

  • The customer saves.
  • Its page shows "Sales Representative" with sales rep A.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Splitting Sales Representatives", Confluence 919928833, version 13 (23 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10890, story SV-11267 (Story 3, Set the representatives on a phone), story SV-11268 (Story 4, Give a customer default representatives)

  • S3-R5: “On a phone, the Edit Customer and New Customer representative fields, their + and remove x work as on a desktop (Story 4), with the same native dropdown (S3-R1).”
  • S4-R7: “Adding Service Parts renames the first field "Sales Representative - Service Labor" and shows "Sales Representative - Service Parts" under it. Both start with the person who was in the first field, or "Unassigned". When that person's Sales Representative switch is off or their account is deactivated, the first field keeps them, as "Elliot Brennan (Inactive)" (S4-N2), and the added Service Parts field starts "Unassigned".”
  • S4-R11: “Removing Service Parts renames the first field "Sales Representative" again. It keeps the Service Labor person, who becomes the customer's one representative for labor and parts. A Part Sales field, if added, keeps its choice.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.
